choices.content: Fixing a wooden strip to a wall with two nails
Straightening a winding river channel to shorten the sailing distance
Taking a straight path from the classroom doorway to the teacher's platform gives the shortest distance
Measuring the perpendicular segment from the landing point to the takeoff line when recording a long jump

question.prompt: Which of the following phenomena can be explained by “two points determine a line”?

solutions.explanation: The two nails correspond to two points. Since the line through two points is unique, the wooden strip is fixed in place. The other examples are applications of “the line segment between two points is the shortest path” and “the perpendicular segment is the shortest.”
solutions.title: Two points determine a line
